name: portfolio_members
query: create table if not exists public.portfolio_members (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), email text not null unique, display_name text not null default '', role text not null default 'viewer' check (role in ('admin','editor','viewer')), created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now()); alter table public.portfolio_members enable row level security; drop policy if exists portfolio_members_self_read on public.portfolio_members; create policy portfolio_members_self_read on public.portfolio_members for select to authenticated using (lower(email) = lower(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', '')));
